panels.description:
MRs reviewed, approvals, change requests (GitLab unapprovals) and comments given per reviewer on other people's MRs (top 20). Reviews on MRs imported from GitHub are left out.
datasource: pull_request_comments, pull_requests, project_mapping, accounts

targets.rawSql:
-- Per reviewer, on other people's MRs: distinct MRs reviewed, approvals, change requests (GitLab unapprovals, stored as NORMAL comments) and comments, top 20.
-- Reviews on MRs imported from GitHub are left out (the not_imported_mr constant, shared with dashboards A, C, G, I
-- and J): the import account approved them while importing, so they are not its own activity.
SELECT COALESCE(REPLACE(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(a.full_name, _utf8mb4 X'E2808B', '')), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(a.user_name), '')), '-', ' '), '(unmapped)')                                                  AS developer,
       COUNT(DISTINCT c.pull_request_id)                               AS `Distinct MRs Reviewed`,
       SUM((c.status = 'CHANGES_REQUESTED' OR c.body LIKE '**Review:** Changes requested%'))                                    AS `Change Requests`,
       SUM(((c.type = 'REVIEW' AND c.status = 'APPROVED') OR c.body LIKE '**Review:** Approved%'))                                          AS Approvals,
       SUM((c.type IN ('NORMAL', 'DIFF') AND NOT (c.status = 'CHANGES_REQUESTED' OR c.body LIKE '**Review:** Changes requested%') AND NOT ((c.type = 'REVIEW' AND c.status = 'APPROVED') OR c.body LIKE '**Review:** Approved%') AND NOT (c.body LIKE '*Created by%' OR c.body LIKE '*Merged by%') AND NOT (c.body LIKE 'Preparing PR description%' OR c.body LIKE 'Preparing review%' OR c.body LIKE '## PR Reviewer Guide%' OR c.body LIKE '## PR Code Suggestions%' OR c.body LIKE '**[Persistent review]%' OR c.body LIKE '**[PR Description]%')))                                           AS Comments
FROM pull_request_comments c
JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = c.pull_request_id
JOIN accounts a       ON a.id = c.account_id AND a.id IN ( ${developer_id} )
WHERE pr.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
  AND ${not_imported_mr:raw}
  AND c.account_id <> pr.author_id
  AND NOT (c.body LIKE '*Created by%' OR c.body LIKE '*Merged by%') AND NOT (c.body LIKE 'Preparing PR description%' OR c.body LIKE 'Preparing review%' OR c.body LIKE '## PR Reviewer Guide%' OR c.body LIKE '## PR Code Suggestions%' OR c.body LIKE '**[Persistent review]%' OR c.body LIKE '**[PR Description]%')
  AND $__timeFilter(c.created_date)
  AND pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
               WHERE pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id
                 AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
                 AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
GROUP BY a.id
ORDER BY (`Change Requests` + Approvals + Comments + `Distinct MRs Reviewed`) DESC
LIMIT 20;

panels.title: Review Activity

panels.description:
Approvals and change requests received from other people per MR author (top 20). MRs imported from GitHub are left out.
datasource: pull_request_comments, pull_requests, accounts, project_mapping

targets.rawSql:
-- Per MR author: approvals and change requests received from other people on MRs created in the range, top 20.
-- GitHub B counts merged PRs as Approved; this counts real approvals.
-- MRs imported from GitHub are left out (the not_imported_mr constant, shared with dashboards A, C, G, I and J).
SELECT COALESCE(REPLACE(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(a.full_name, _utf8mb4 X'E2808B', '')), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(a.user_name), '')), '-', ' '), '(unmapped)')                                                  AS Developer,
       SUM(((c.type = 'REVIEW' AND c.status = 'APPROVED') OR c.body LIKE '**Review:** Approved%'))                                          AS `Approvals Received`,
       SUM((c.status = 'CHANGES_REQUESTED' OR c.body LIKE '**Review:** Changes requested%'))                                    AS `Change Requests Received`
FROM pull_requests pr
JOIN accounts a ON a.id = pr.author_id AND a.id IN ( ${developer_id} )
JOIN pull_request_comments c
  ON c.pull_request_id = pr.id
 AND c.account_id <> pr.author_id
 AND (((c.type = 'REVIEW' AND c.status = 'APPROVED') OR c.body LIKE '**Review:** Approved%') OR (c.status = 'CHANGES_REQUESTED' OR c.body LIKE '**Review:** Changes requested%'))
WHERE pr.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
  AND ${not_imported_mr:raw}
  AND $__timeFilter(pr.created_date)
  AND pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
               WHERE pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id
                 AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
                 AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
GROUP BY a.id
ORDER BY (`Approvals Received` + `Change Requests Received`) DESC
LIMIT 20;

panels.title: Review Outcome Mix

panels.description:
Lines added and deleted per contributor, excluding merge commits (top 20). Commit authors are matched to GitLab accounts by email; unmatched commits are left out.
datasource: commits, repo_commits, commit_parents, project_mapping, accounts

targets.rawSql:
-- Lines added and removed per developer from the repo's commits, merge commits excluded, top 20.
-- Commit authors are matched to GitLab accounts by email (see commit_authors); unmatched commits are left out.
WITH scoped_commits AS (
  -- the repo's commits in the range, merge commits excluded
  SELECT DISTINCT c.sha, c.author_email, c.author_name, c.additions, c.deletions
  FROM commits c
  JOIN repo_commits rc ON rc.commit_sha = c.sha
  WHERE rc.repo_id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
    AND rc.repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
               WHERE pm.row_id = rc.repo_id
                 AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
                 AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
    AND $__timeFilter(c.authored_date)
    AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM commit_parents cp WHERE cp.commit_sha = c.sha) < 2
),
gitlab_accounts AS (
  SELECT a.id, LOWER(a.user_name) AS login, LOWER(TRIM(a.full_name)) AS name
  FROM accounts a
  WHERE a.id LIKE 'gitlab:GitlabAccount:%' AND a.id NOT LIKE 'gitlab:GitlabAccount:%:0'
),
commit_authors AS (
  -- GitLab accounts carry no email, so a commit author is matched to a GitLab account by the email's local part
  -- against the username, then by the author name against the username, then by a unique full name.
  SELECT e.author_email,
         e.author_name,
         COALESCE(
           MIN(by_email.id),
           MIN(by_login.id),
           CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT by_name.id) = 1 THEN MIN(by_name.id) END
         ) AS account_id
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT author_email, author_name FROM (SELECT author_email, author_name FROM scoped_commits) s) e
  LEFT JOIN gitlab_accounts by_email ON by_email.login = LOWER(SUBSTRING_INDEX(e.author_email, '@', 1))
  LEFT JOIN gitlab_accounts by_login ON by_login.login = LOWER(TRIM(e.author_name))
  LEFT JOIN gitlab_accounts by_name  ON by_name.name   = LOWER(TRIM(e.author_name))
  GROUP BY e.author_email, e.author_name
)
SELECT COALESCE(REPLACE(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(a.full_name, _utf8mb4 X'E2808B', '')), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(a.user_name), '')), '-', ' '), '(unmapped)')         AS contributor,
       SUM(sc.additions)      AS `Lines Added`,
       SUM(sc.deletions)      AS `Lines Removed`
FROM scoped_commits sc
JOIN commit_authors ca ON ca.author_email <=> sc.author_email AND ca.author_name <=> sc.author_name
JOIN accounts a        ON a.id = ca.account_id AND a.id IN ( ${developer_id} )
GROUP BY a.id
ORDER BY SUM(sc.additions) + SUM(sc.deletions) DESC
LIMIT 20;

panels.title: Contributions By Commits

panels.description:
MR commits authored in the range, per developer, that landed (MR merged) vs were abandoned (MR closed unmerged). Includes commits later squashed away; merge commits are excluded where parent data was collected.
datasource: pull_request_commits, pull_requests, project_mapping, accounts

targets.rawSql:
-- Counts each MR commit once per developer: Landed if any of its MRs merged, Abandoned if its MRs were only closed unmerged, top 20.
WITH mr_commits AS (
  -- each MR commit once, merge commits excluded: landed if any of its MRs merged, closed if any of its MRs closed unmerged
  SELECT prc.commit_sha,
         MAX(prc.commit_author_email)  AS author_email,
         MAX(prc.commit_author_name)   AS author_name,
         MAX(pr.status = 'MERGED')     AS landed,
         MAX(pr.status = 'CLOSED')     AS closed
  FROM pull_request_commits prc
  JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = prc.pull_request_id
  WHERE pr.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
    AND pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
               WHERE pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id
                 AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
                 AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
    AND $__timeFilter(prc.commit_authored_date)
    AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM commit_parents cp WHERE cp.commit_sha = prc.commit_sha) < 2
  GROUP BY prc.commit_sha
),
gitlab_accounts AS (
  SELECT a.id, LOWER(a.user_name) AS login, LOWER(TRIM(a.full_name)) AS name
  FROM accounts a
  WHERE a.id LIKE 'gitlab:GitlabAccount:%' AND a.id NOT LIKE 'gitlab:GitlabAccount:%:0'
),
commit_authors AS (
  -- GitLab accounts carry no email, so a commit author is matched to a GitLab account by the email's local part
  -- against the username, then by the author name against the username, then by a unique full name.
  SELECT e.author_email,
         e.author_name,
         COALESCE(
           MIN(by_email.id),
           MIN(by_login.id),
           CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT by_name.id) = 1 THEN MIN(by_name.id) END
         ) AS account_id
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT author_email, author_name FROM (SELECT author_email, author_name FROM mr_commits) s) e
  LEFT JOIN gitlab_accounts by_email ON by_email.login = LOWER(SUBSTRING_INDEX(e.author_email, '@', 1))
  LEFT JOIN gitlab_accounts by_login ON by_login.login = LOWER(TRIM(e.author_name))
  LEFT JOIN gitlab_accounts by_name  ON by_name.name   = LOWER(TRIM(e.author_name))
  GROUP BY e.author_email, e.author_name
)
SELECT COALESCE(REPLACE(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(a.full_name, _utf8mb4 X'E2808B', '')), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(a.user_name), '')), '-', ' '), '(unmapped)')                       AS developer,
       SUM(mc.landed)                       AS Landed,
       SUM(mc.closed AND NOT mc.landed)     AS Abandoned
FROM mr_commits mc
JOIN commit_authors ca ON ca.author_email <=> mc.author_email AND ca.author_name <=> mc.author_name
JOIN accounts a        ON a.id = ca.account_id AND a.id IN ( ${developer_id} )
GROUP BY a.id
ORDER BY SUM(mc.landed) + SUM(mc.closed AND NOT mc.landed) DESC
LIMIT 20;

panels.title: Commits Outcome

panels.description:
Per-developer scorecard of commits, MR contributions, reviews given and MRs authored. Each column uses the same filter as its panel. MRs imported from GitHub, and the reviews on them, are left out, so they are not credited to the importing account.
datasource: pull_requests, project_mapping, commits, repo_commits, commit_parents, accounts, pull_request_commits, pull_request_comments

targets.rawSql:
-- Per-developer scorecard keyed by GitLab account. Each column is filtered the same way as its own panel: commits and lines
-- and MR commits landed or abandoned by commit date (merge commits excluded), reviews given by review date, and MRs opened
-- and merged, and change requests received, by MR creation date.
-- MRs imported from GitHub, and the reviews on them, are left out (the not_imported_mr constant, shared with
-- dashboards A, C, G, I and J): the import account created them, so they are not its own activity.
WITH scoped_prs AS (
  SELECT pr.id, pr.author_id, pr.status
  FROM pull_requests pr
  WHERE pr.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
    AND ${not_imported_mr:raw}
    AND $__timeFilter(pr.created_date)
    AND pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
               WHERE pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id
                 AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
                 AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
),
scoped_commits AS (
  -- the repo's commits in the range, merge commits excluded
  SELECT DISTINCT c.sha, c.author_email, c.author_name, c.additions, c.deletions
  FROM commits c
  JOIN repo_commits rc ON rc.commit_sha = c.sha
  WHERE rc.repo_id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
    AND rc.repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
               WHERE pm.row_id = rc.repo_id
                 AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
                 AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
    AND $__timeFilter(c.authored_date)
    AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM commit_parents cp WHERE cp.commit_sha = c.sha) < 2
),
mr_commits AS (
  -- each MR commit once, merge commits excluded: landed if any of its MRs merged, closed if any of its MRs closed unmerged
  SELECT prc.commit_sha,
         MAX(prc.commit_author_email)  AS author_email,
         MAX(prc.commit_author_name)   AS author_name,
         MAX(pr.status = 'MERGED')     AS landed,
         MAX(pr.status = 'CLOSED')     AS closed
  FROM pull_request_commits prc
  JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = prc.pull_request_id
  WHERE pr.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
    AND pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
               WHERE pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id
                 AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
                 AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
    AND $__timeFilter(prc.commit_authored_date)
    AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM commit_parents cp WHERE cp.commit_sha = prc.commit_sha) < 2
  GROUP BY prc.commit_sha
),
gitlab_accounts AS (
  SELECT a.id, LOWER(a.user_name) AS login, LOWER(TRIM(a.full_name)) AS name
  FROM accounts a
  WHERE a.id LIKE 'gitlab:GitlabAccount:%' AND a.id NOT LIKE 'gitlab:GitlabAccount:%:0'
),
commit_authors AS (
  -- GitLab accounts carry no email, so a commit author is matched to a GitLab account by the email's local part
  -- against the username, then by the author name against the username, then by a unique full name.
  SELECT e.author_email,
         e.author_name,
         COALESCE(
           MIN(by_email.id),
           MIN(by_login.id),
           CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT by_name.id) = 1 THEN MIN(by_name.id) END
         ) AS account_id
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT author_email, author_name FROM (SELECT author_email, author_name FROM scoped_commits UNION SELECT author_email, author_name FROM mr_commits) s) e
  LEFT JOIN gitlab_accounts by_email ON by_email.login = LOWER(SUBSTRING_INDEX(e.author_email, '@', 1))
  LEFT JOIN gitlab_accounts by_login ON by_login.login = LOWER(TRIM(e.author_name))
  LEFT JOIN gitlab_accounts by_name  ON by_name.name   = LOWER(TRIM(e.author_name))
  GROUP BY e.author_email, e.author_name
),

code_volume AS (
  SELECT ca.account_id,
         COUNT(DISTINCT sc.sha)  AS commits,
         SUM(sc.additions)       AS lines_added,
         SUM(sc.deletions)       AS lines_deleted
  FROM scoped_commits sc
  JOIN commit_authors ca ON ca.author_email <=> sc.author_email AND ca.author_name <=> sc.author_name
  GROUP BY ca.account_id
),

contributed AS (
  SELECT ca.account_id,
         SUM(mc.landed)                     AS commits_landed,
         SUM(mc.closed AND NOT mc.landed)   AS commits_abandoned
  FROM mr_commits mc
  JOIN commit_authors ca ON ca.author_email <=> mc.author_email AND ca.author_name <=> mc.author_name
  GROUP BY ca.account_id
),

reviewed AS (
  SELECT c.account_id,
         SUM(((c.type = 'REVIEW' AND c.status = 'APPROVED') OR c.body LIKE '**Review:** Approved%'))                AS approvals_given,
         SUM((c.status = 'CHANGES_REQUESTED' OR c.body LIKE '**Review:** Changes requested%'))          AS change_requests_given,
         SUM((c.type IN ('NORMAL', 'DIFF') AND NOT (c.status = 'CHANGES_REQUESTED' OR c.body LIKE '**Review:** Changes requested%') AND NOT ((c.type = 'REVIEW' AND c.status = 'APPROVED') OR c.body LIKE '**Review:** Approved%') AND NOT (c.body LIKE '*Created by%' OR c.body LIKE '*Merged by%') AND NOT (c.body LIKE 'Preparing PR description%' OR c.body LIKE 'Preparing review%' OR c.body LIKE '## PR Reviewer Guide%' OR c.body LIKE '## PR Code Suggestions%' OR c.body LIKE '**[Persistent review]%' OR c.body LIKE '**[PR Description]%')))                 AS comments_given,
         COUNT(DISTINCT c.pull_request_id)     AS mrs_reviewed
  FROM pull_request_comments c
  JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = c.pull_request_id
                       AND c.account_id <> pr.author_id
  WHERE pr.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
    AND ${not_imported_mr:raw}
    AND pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
               WHERE pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id
                 AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
                 AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
    AND $__timeFilter(c.created_date)
    AND NOT (c.body LIKE '*Created by%' OR c.body LIKE '*Merged by%') AND NOT (c.body LIKE 'Preparing PR description%' OR c.body LIKE 'Preparing review%' OR c.body LIKE '## PR Reviewer Guide%' OR c.body LIKE '## PR Code Suggestions%' OR c.body LIKE '**[Persistent review]%' OR c.body LIKE '**[PR Description]%')
  GROUP BY c.account_id
),

authored AS (
  SELECT pr.author_id                                                  AS account_id,
         COUNT(DISTINCT pr.id)                                         AS mrs_opened,
         COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pr.status = 'MERGED' THEN pr.id END) AS mrs_merged,
         COUNT(c.id)                                                   AS change_requests_received
  FROM scoped_prs pr
  LEFT JOIN pull_request_comments c
         ON c.pull_request_id = pr.id
        AND (c.status = 'CHANGES_REQUESTED' OR c.body LIKE '**Review:** Changes requested%')
        AND c.account_id <> pr.author_id
  GROUP BY pr.author_id
),

spine AS (
  SELECT account_id FROM code_volume
  UNION SELECT account_id FROM contributed
  UNION SELECT account_id FROM authored
  UNION SELECT account_id FROM reviewed
)

SELECT COALESCE(REPLACE(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(a.full_name, _utf8mb4 X'E2808B', '')), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(a.user_name), '')), '-', ' '), '(unmapped)')                                AS `Developer`,

       COALESCE(cv.commits,       0)                 AS `Commits`,
       COALESCE(cv.lines_added,   0)                 AS `Lines Added`,
       COALESCE(cv.lines_deleted, 0)                 AS `Lines Deleted`,
       COALESCE(co.commits_landed,    0)             AS `Commits Landed`,
       COALESCE(co.commits_abandoned, 0)             AS `Commits Abandoned`,

       COALESCE(au.mrs_opened,               0)      AS `MRs Opened`,
       COALESCE(au.mrs_merged,               0)      AS `MRs Merged`,
       COALESCE(au.change_requests_received, 0)      AS `Change Requests Received`,

       COALESCE(rv.mrs_reviewed,          0)         AS `MRs Reviewed`,
       COALESCE(rv.approvals_given,       0)         AS `Approvals Given`,
       COALESCE(rv.change_requests_given, 0)         AS `Change Requests Given`,
       COALESCE(rv.comments_given,        0)         AS `Comments Given`

FROM spine s
JOIN accounts a          ON a.id = s.account_id AND a.id IN ( ${developer_id} )
LEFT JOIN code_volume cv ON cv.account_id = s.account_id
LEFT JOIN contributed co ON co.account_id = s.account_id
LEFT JOIN authored    au ON au.account_id = s.account_id
LEFT JOIN reviewed    rv ON rv.account_id = s.account_id
ORDER BY `Developer`;

list.definition:
WITH scoped_repos AS (
  SELECT r.id
  FROM repos r
  WHERE r.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
    AND r.deleted = 0
    AND r.id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
                 WHERE pm.row_id  = r.id
                   AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
                   AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
),
scoped_issues AS (
  -- gitlab board ids match repo ids
  SELECT bi.issue_id
  FROM board_issues bi
  WHERE bi.board_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
                 WHERE pm.row_id  = bi.board_id
                   AND pm.`table` = 'boards'
                   AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
),
scoped_accounts AS (
  -- MR authors
  SELECT pr.author_id AS account_id, NULL AS fallback_name, 0 AS assignee
  FROM pull_requests pr
  JOIN scoped_repos sr ON sr.id = pr.base_repo_id
  WHERE pr.author_id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
  UNION
  -- MR reviewers and commenters
  SELECT cmt.account_id, NULL, 0
  FROM pull_request_comments cmt
  JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = cmt.pull_request_id
  JOIN scoped_repos sr  ON sr.id = pr.base_repo_id
  WHERE cmt.account_id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
  UNION
  -- issue assignees, from issue_assignees and issues.assignee_id (the :0 placeholder means unassigned)
  SELECT ia.assignee_id, ia.assignee_name, 1
  FROM issue_assignees ia
  JOIN scoped_issues si ON si.issue_id = ia.issue_id
  WHERE ia.assignee_id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
  UNION
  SELECT i.assignee_id, i.assignee_name, 1
  FROM issues i
  JOIN scoped_issues si ON si.issue_id = i.id
  WHERE i.assignee_id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
    AND i.assignee_id NOT LIKE 'gitlab:GitlabAccount:%:0'
  UNION
  -- commit authors matched to a GitLab account (see commit_authors), so commit-only contributors are selectable
  SELECT ca.account_id, NULL, 0
  FROM (WITH gitlab_accounts AS (
  SELECT a.id, LOWER(a.user_name) AS login, LOWER(TRIM(a.full_name)) AS name
  FROM accounts a
  WHERE a.id LIKE 'gitlab:GitlabAccount:%' AND a.id NOT LIKE 'gitlab:GitlabAccount:%:0'
),
commit_authors AS (
  -- GitLab accounts carry no email, so a commit author is matched to a GitLab account by the email's local part
  -- against the username, then by the author name against the username, then by a unique full name.
  SELECT e.author_email,
         e.author_name,
         COALESCE(
           MIN(by_email.id),
           MIN(by_login.id),
           CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT by_name.id) = 1 THEN MIN(by_name.id) END
         ) AS account_id
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT author_email, author_name FROM (SELECT c.author_email, c.author_name FROM commits c JOIN repo_commits rc ON rc.commit_sha = c.sha WHERE rc.repo_id IN (SELECT id FROM scoped_repos)) s) e
  LEFT JOIN gitlab_accounts by_email ON by_email.login = LOWER(SUBSTRING_INDEX(e.author_email, '@', 1))
  LEFT JOIN gitlab_accounts by_login ON by_login.login = LOWER(TRIM(e.author_name))
  LEFT JOIN gitlab_accounts by_name  ON by_name.name   = LOWER(TRIM(e.author_name))
  GROUP BY e.author_email, e.author_name
)
SELECT account_id FROM commit_authors) ca
  WHERE ca.account_id IS NOT NULL
)
-- assignees with no account row keep their GitLab username; bots are left out
SELECT CONCAT(COALESCE(REPLACE(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(a.full_name, _utf8mb4 X'E2808B', '')), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(a.user_name), '')), '-', ' '), REPLACE(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(MAX(sa.fallback_name), _utf8mb4 X'E2808B', '')), ''), '-', ' '), sa.account_id), '--', sa.account_id) AS Name
FROM scoped_accounts sa
LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = sa.account_id
GROUP BY sa.account_id, a.full_name, a.user_name
HAVING NOT COALESCE(a.user_name, '') REGEXP '^(project|group)_[0-9]+_bot_'
ORDER BY Name

list.description: Org-specific. An MR counts as imported from GitHub when its description or a comment starts with "*Created by", or when the import account (tayyab-razzaq) created it before 2021-07-01. Admins should change the account and date to their own import, or drop that part, and keep this the same on every dashboard that has it.
